sentences.text: 1 2. Liberty is granted to serve the standing counsel for the State of Bihar.

3. Till the next date of hearing, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.13 of 2020 dated 06th April, 2020 registered at Police Station NTPC, Sub-Division-Fahmgaun, District Bhagalpur under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, subject to his joining investigation as and when called upon to do so by the investigating officer.

4. In the counter affidavit that we call upon the respondent-State to file two days prior to the returnable date, it may be indicated whether the petitioner was called upon to join investigation by issuance of notice by the investigating officer and whether he has responded to such notice.

(RASHMI DHYANI PANT) (SUDHIR KUMAR SHARMA)
 ASST. REGISTRAR-CUM-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
